definition: to open a door.

definition: to go upward; to jump up.
example_en: The fish jumped up out of the water.

definition: to wash; to clean by means of water.
example_en: He washed the vessels clean with water.

definition: a woman whocannot produce offspring; a barren woman.
example: ಆ ಹಸು ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಗೊಡ್ಡಿಯಾಗಿಯೇ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: That cow has remained barren for many years.

definition: (fig.) to be tarnished, besmirched; to be sullied.
example_en: His good name was tarnished by lies.

definition: knowing no evil; innocent.
example_en: That child was smiling in a very innocent manner.

definition: a leg that is not straight; a bent, crooked leg.
example_en: He developed a crooked leg after the accident.

definition: the hollow between the frontal globes of an elephant.
example: ಆನೆಯ ಹಣೆಯ ಬಳಿಯ ವಿದುವನ್ನು ಮಾವುತ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The mahout touched the hollow between the elephant's frontal globes.

definition: to smoothen (the surface of).
example_en: The carpenter smoothened the surface of the plank with sandpaper.

definition: to wash thoroughly in water.
example: ಅವಳು ಹೊಸ ಪಾತ್ರೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಅಲುಂಬಿದಳು.
example_en: She washed the new vessels thoroughly in water.

definition: the quality of being agreeable and tasty; tastiness.
example_en: Everyone liked the tastiness of this fruit.

definition: the precious yellow metallic element, highly malleable and ductile, and not subject to oxidation or corrosion (symbol: Au); gold.
example_en: There was a gold ring on his finger.

definition: to confuse as to keep from understanding or solving; to puzzle; to confound; to baffle.
example_en: The riddle baffled her.

definition: a sari (a garment worn by Indian women, consisting of a long piece of cotton or silk wrapped around the body with one end draped over the head or over one shoulder) of light saffron colour.
example_en: She wore a light saffron sari.

definition: the acting of pulling towards; attraction.
example_en: That song had a special attraction.

definition: the plant Physalis peruviana (= P. edulis) of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The fruit of the Physalis plant is yellow in colour.

definition: to come towards or in; to arrive.
example_en: The guests arrived home in the evening.

definition: he who habitually disheartens, discourages others.
example_en: He is a habitual discourager who never encourages anyone.

definition: something said or written in return to a question, argument, letter, etc.; an answer.
example_en: He gave his answer in the court.

definition: the moonlight.
example_en: The moonlight illuminated the whole garden.

definition: a man who possesses (great) wealth; a wealthy man.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಆಢ್ಯ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದ.
example_en: The wealthy man of that town helped the poor.

definition: the state of being assimilated with one's blood.
example_en: That poison spread, assimilated into the blood.

definition: the act of stickering; agglutination.
example_en: The gluing of the two sheets did not happen properly.

definition: a remittance to the government treasury the land revenue collected.
example_en: The officer sent the remittance of land revenue to the treasury.

definition: a slender waist.
example_en: The dancer's slender waist caught the onlookers' attention.

definition: to amuse oneself, as by taking part in a game or sport; engage in recreation; to play.
example_en: The children were playing in the field in the evening.

definition: the rear portion.
example_en: The soldiers were guarding at the rear.

definition: along with; togeher with.
example_en: He travelled along with his friends.

definition: a shaking vehemently.
example_en: The trees bent from the storm's vehement shaking.

definition: to stand up (from a sitting or lying position); to get up.
example_en: I told him to get up from the chair.

definition: the act or fact of becoming, happening or producing.
example: ಈ ಘಟನೆಯ ಆದಲೆ ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರಿಗೆ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The occurrence of this event surprised the villagers.

definition: the cardinal one thousand eight.
example_en: The temple's hymn contains one thousand and eight names.

definition: to satisfy completely.
example_en: The shopkeeper tried to completely satisfy the customers.

definition: the tree Grewia scabrophylla of Tiliaceae family; Indian linden.
example_en: The farmers rested in the shade of the Indian linden tree.

definition: one of the major Dravidian languages, and spoken mainly by people in Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka.
example: ತಿಗುಳು ಭಾಷೆ ಶ್ರೀಲಂಕಾ ಮತ್ತು ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The Tamil language is spoken in Sri Lanka and Tamil Nadu.

definition: to prepare an emulsion or gel.
example_en: The physician prepared a medicinal gel from herbs.

definition: the chilli plant Capsicum frutescens of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The farmer nourished the chilli plant in the field with water.

definition: an onomatopoeic word formed by imitating the sound made by hurried movement.
example_en: The sound of hurried movement was heard as the horses galloped.

definition: a request, appeal, etc. given in writing; a petition.
example_en: He wrote and sent a petition to the district collector.

definition: driven by fate or destiny.
example: ಅವನ ಕಾರ್ಯ ವಿಧಿಪ್ರೇರಿತವಾಗಿತ್ತು ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone said that his action was driven by fate.

definition: a queen.
example_en: The queen gave a donation to the temple.

definition: a drain, for carrying off water and waste matter; a sewer.
example_en: Sewage water is flowing in the drain.

definition: the reaping of crops; harvest.
example: ಹತ್ತಿಯ ಕುಯಲು ಮುಗಿಸಿ ರೈತರು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಹೋದರು.
example_en: Having finished the cotton harvest, the farmers went to the market.

definition: the lowest or last, segment of the large intestine, extending, in humans, from the sigmoid flexure to the anus; the rectum.
example_en: The doctor performed surgery on the rectum.

definition: the act of sucking, absorbing in (a liquid) .
example: ಸ್ಟ್ರಾ ಮೂಲಕ ರಸದ ಹೀರಿಕೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The sucking up of the juice through the straw happened quickly.

definition: (sl.) the periodically discharged menses from the uterus of women.
example_en: Her menses were delayed this month.

definition: the act of smearing oil, ointment etc. on the body.
example_en: Applying kohl to the eyes is an old custom.

definition: the ability of a person to acquire knowledge by ingenuity or creativity.
example_en: That artist's creative ingenuity surprised everyone.

definition: to spread out; to become sparse.
example_en: The clouds spread out and became sparse in the sky.

definition: to scatter (liquid, ashes, powder, etc.) in small drops or particles; to sprinkle.
example_en: The children sprinkled colored water on each other.

definition: earnestness; sincerity.
example_en: The teacher was pleased with the student's sincerity.

definition: the tree Guazuma tomentosa ( = Buboma tomentosa) of Sterculiaceae family.
example_en: People use the bark of the Guazuma tomentosa tree for medicine.

definition: a mental leaning or inclination of a biased mind; partiality; prejudice; biasedness.
example_en: There should be no bias in the judge's verdict.

definition: amounting to twice.
example_en: This time the income grew to twice the amount.

definition: a falling down.
example: ಆ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಪಾತಿತ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The falling down of that wall surprised everyone.

definition: a particular type of game played with cards.
example_en: The children were playing ranisalu in the evening.

definition: the plant Hibiscus mutabilis of Malvaceae family.
example_en: The Hibiscus mutabilis plant had bloomed in the garden.

definition: a playing in the soil or dust.
example_en: The children were playing in the dirt in the yard.

definition: (said of flies) to gather and fly off in a swarm with a continuous murmuring sound.
example_en: As evening fell, the flies gathered and flew off swarming with a murmur.

definition: daily usage.
example_en: This is an item of our household's daily usage.

definition: the act of sowing seeds.
example_en: The farmers began sowing seeds in the rainy season.

definition: a lulling sound.
example: ತಾಯಿ ಮಗುವನ್ನು ಜೊ ಎಂದು ಹಾಡಿ ನಿದ್ರೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother sang a lulling sound and put the baby to sleep.

definition: any hymenopterous insect of the superfamily Apoidea, including social and solitary species of several families, as the bumblebees, honeybees, etc.; a bee.
example: ರೋಲಂಬವು ಹೂವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಮಕರಂದವನ್ನು ಹೀರಿತು.
example_en: The bee sat on the flower and sucked the nectar.

definition: an ill-fated, unlucky woman.
example_en: That ill-fated woman lived alone without children.

definition: skill - a) great ability or proficiency; expertness that comes from training, practice, etc.; b) an art, craft or science, esp. one involving the use of the hands or body; c) ability in such an art, craft or science.
example_en: That craftsman's skill pleased everyone.

definition: abstention from food; fasting.
example_en: The devotees observed fasting on the festival day.

definition: the ficus tree Ficus callosa of Moraceae family.
example_en: A tagadu-goli fig tree was seen at the edge of the forest.

definition: to cause to come into physical contact; to fix with or as with an adhesive; to sticker.
example_en: He fixed the poster onto the wall.

definition: a lightly covered pit used as a trap for animals; a pitfall.
example_en: The deer fell into the pitfall and got trapped.

definition: a folded paper container as for a letter, usu. with a gummed flap for sealing; an envelope.
example_en: He put the letter in an envelope and sealed it.

definition: the space between two columns, timbers or walls of a house; a bay; intercolumniation.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಮನೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಕಣವೂ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಂಬಗಳಿಂದ ಆವೃತವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Every bay of the old house was surrounded by stone pillars.

definition: (geol.) epigenetic - a) produced on or near the surface of the earth; b) formed or deposited later than the enclosing rocks(said of ore deposits, structures, etc).
example_en: Epigenetic mineral deposits are found near the surface.

definition: a person who owns, controls or has an important position in the management of an industrial enterprise; a businessman; an industrialist.
example: ಆ ಉದ್ದಮಿದಾರ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That businessman established a large factory in the town.

definition: he who diffuses, spreads or scatters (something).
example_en: That spreader spread the news all over the village.

definition: the opening at the lower end of the alimentary canal, through which the solid refuse of digestion is excreted; the anus.
example_en: The doctor examined the patient's anal region.

definition: utterance of a hymn or hymns.
example: ಮದುವೆಯ ವಿಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂತ್ರಾಗಮ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The chanting of hymns plays a key role in the wedding ritual.

definition: that which is dreadful, horrible.
example: ಆ ಜಾಲಿಮ ಘಟನೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Everyone was shocked to hear that dreadful incident.

definition: a lath used in making a roof; a reeper.
example_en: They fixed the reepers to the frame and laid the roof.

definition: a man engaged or involved (in something) with great interest.
example_en: He was deeply engaged in his work.

definition: a sea.
example_en: The ship sailed across the sea.

definition: (buddh.) a priest or monk in Lamaism.
example: ಆ ಮಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿರಿಯ ಲಾಮ ಪೂಜೆ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: The senior lama conducted worship at that monastery.

definition: a condition in which the faeces are hard and elimination from the bowels is infrequent and difficult; constipation.
example_en: Food without fibre causes constipation.

definition: an acute infectious disease caused by the bacillus Bordetella pertussis, usu. affecting children, characterised by a mucous discharge from the nose and later by repeated attacks of coughing that end in a forced intake of breath or whoop; the whooping cough.
example_en: The child had whooping cough and was coughing repeatedly.

definition: immediately; suddenly; without due restraint.
example_en: She got up suddenly and ran without restraint.

definition: that which is supposed to have been predetermined in everyone's life by the universal principle or ultimate agency; fate.
example: ಬೊಮ್ಮಬರೆಹವನ್ನು ಯಾರೂ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲಾರರು ಎಂದು ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother used to say that no one can change what fate has written.

definition: to be accomplished; to be completed or achieved.
example_en: That plan was finally accomplished.

definition: a long, deep, audible breath exhaled as from disappointment, in expressing sorrow, longing, etc.; a sigh.
example: ಅವನ ಬಾಯಿಂದ ಒಂದು ದೀರ್ಘ ನಿಡುಸುಯಲ್ ಹೊರಬಂತು.
example_en: A long, deep sigh came out from his mouth.

definition: that which can be measured; a thing that is measurable.
example: ಭೂಮಿಯ ದೂರ ಮೇಯ ಎಂದು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Scientists say the distance of the earth is a measurable thing.

definition: being emitted from the cheek; (as sweat).
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನ ಬೇಗೆಯಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಡೋದ್ಗಾರಿ ಬೆವರು ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Sweat emitted from his cheek appeared due to the heat of the sun.

definition: a woman who has the inclination for disciplined orderly way or manner.
example_en: She became known as a woman of disciplined manner.

definition: the central stone piece in the arch.
example_en: The central keystone sat firmly at the middle of the arch.

definition: warm and cozy sunlight of the early part of the day.
example_en: Sitting in the warm early sunlight and drinking tea is a joy.

definition: an utterly disordered, confusing condition.
example_en: Everything in the house has fallen into an utterly disordered condition and nothing can be found.

definition: lotus flower, that has a large number of petals.
example_en: She had brought a many-petalled lotus flower for the worship.

definition: to cast a spell over; to enchant; to bewitch.
example_en: The sorcerer enchanted the people with his spell.

definition: a mattress used to sleep on, consisting of a quilted or similarly fastened case, usu. of heavy cloth; a bed.
example_en: That bed was very soft.

definition: something whispered; whispered sound, speech, etc.; whispering.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವಿನ ಕುಣುಕುಣು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The whispering between the two attracted everyone's attention.

definition: (arch.) a kind of tax.
example_en: In ancient times farmers had to pay the vara tax.

definition: any of various evergreen plants of mistletoe family parasitic on deciduous or evergreen trees with small, yellowish-green leaves, yellowish flowers and shiny, white, poisonous berries; mistletoe.
example_en: Mistletoe had grown on the branch of the mango tree.

definition: the authority to control.
example_en: The king had authority to control the whole kingdom.

definition: (pl.) five corners; five angles.
example_en: That fort had walls with five corners.

definition: (masc.) one who has heard anything.
example: ಶ್ರುತಾರ್ಥನಾದ ಆ ಮುನಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಗಳನ್ನೂ ಕೇಳಿ ತಿಳಿದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That sage, having heard everything, knew all the scriptures.

definition: the shape of a circle; a circular shape.
example_en: That design was in a perfect circular shape.

definition: an educated but stupid fellow.
example: ಓದಿದ್ದರೂ ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಬೆಳ್ಳಕ್ಕರಿಗ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಆಡಿಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: Everyone said he was an educated but stupid fellow.

definition: the state of troubled, distressed mind.
example_en: Her mind was filled with distress.

definition: a nest - a) the structure made or the place chosen by birds for laying their eggs and sheltering their young; b) the place used by turtles, hornets, fish, etc. for spawning or breeding; c) the silky or fibrous case which the larvae of certain insects spin about themselves for shelter during the pupa stage; a cocoon.
example_en: The bird built a nest on the branch of the tree.

definition: an elderly woman.
example_en: That elderly woman used to go to the temple every day.

definition: to explain, delineate, interpret well.
example_en: The teacher explained that verse well.

definition: (yoga.) a particular manner of retention of air within while performing breathing exercises.
example_en: The yogi was sitting performing the sun-piercing breath retention.

definition: gone ahead; moved forward; progressed.
example_en: The new plan progressed rapidly.

definition: the rose plant, Rosa damascena of Rosaceae family, with clusters of white to red flowers, important as a source of attar of roses; damask rose.
example_en: That damask rose was full of fragrance.

definition: brown colour.
example_en: Her sari was of a brown colour.

definition: a thin plate of flexible cartilage in front of the glottis that folds back over and protects the glottis during swallowing; the epiglottis.
example_en: While swallowing food, the epiglottis covers the windpipe.

definition: to think about; to determine, resolve, work out, etc. by reasoning.
example: ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ ಕುರಿತು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಅರವರಿಸಿ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He reasoned carefully about the problem and made a decision.

definition: a man, not having required qualification or not being chartered, carrying on the profession of or acting as a lawyer or legal adviser.
example_en: That unqualified lawyer fabricated false evidence.

definition: an Atchene pony; a horse from Pegu city in Burma (Myamnar) country.
example_en: Traders used to import Atchene ponies.

definition: the quality, fact or condition of being exact or precise; exactness; precision.
example_en: There was great precision in his calculation.

definition: a deep hole (as in the earth).
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಆಳವಾದ ಬೊರಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a deep hole in the middle of the forest.

definition: the state of being intertwined with.
example_en: She untangled the intertwined state of the hair with a comb.

definition: to express or display one's protest insincerely.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಬರಿ ಮೇಲ್ಮಲೆಗೆಯ್ದನಷ್ಟೆ, ನಿಜವಾದ ಅಸಮಾಧಾನ ತೋರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: In the meeting he merely displayed insincere protest, showing no real discontent.

definition: a pain in the head; head-ache.
example: ಜ್ವರದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮಂಡೆಶೂಲೆ ಕೂಡ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: Along with fever, he also had a headache.

definition: the day following the present day or a particular day.
example_en: Everyone rested on the day following the examination.

definition: to become a pandal or a pandal-like.
example_en: Coloured cloths have spread over the street like a pandal.

definition: a contagious skin disease caused by a parasitic mite, resulting in intense itching; big scabies.
example: ಆಣಗಜ್ಜಿ ಅವನ ಇಡೀ ದೇಹಕ್ಕೆ ಹರಡಿ ತುಂಬಾ ತುರಿಕೆ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The scabies spread over his whole body and caused intense itching.

definition: a fabric made by weaving, knitting, etc.; cloth; textile.
example_en: Various kinds of cloth were being sold in that shop.

definition: to perform; to accomplish; to carry out.
example_en: He carried out that work well.

definition: a small chest or box, as for jewels; a casket.
example_en: She carefully kept the pearls in the small casket.

definition: an ignoble lineage or family.
example_en: His ignoble lineage is known to everyone.

definition: the edge of the outer ear.
example_en: There was a small earring on the edge of her outer ear.

definition: a piece of irrigated agricultural field.
example_en: A piece of irrigated agricultural field came to him as ancestral property.

definition: a heavy conflict between two rival armies.
example_en: A heavy war took place between the two kingdoms.

definition: the feeling of great surprise.
example_en: He was struck with great surprise on hearing that news.

definition: fine wheat flour.
example_en: The shopkeeper sells fine wheat flour by the sackful.

definition: old and used goods.
example_en: The old and used goods at home were sold off.

definition: a person who speaks truth in a very blunt manner.
example: ಆ ನಿಷ್ಠೂರವಾದಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಎದುರೂ ನಿಜ ಹೇಳಿಬಿಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That blunt truth-speaker blurts out the truth in front of everyone.

definition: a sub-sect among the Kāḍugolla, a tribal community engaged in pasturing.
example: ಕರಡಿಗೊಲ್ಲ ಜನರು ತಮ್ಮ ದನಗಳನ್ನು ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಯಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The Karadigolla people graze their cattle in the forest.

definition: any of the vedas with its six subsidiaries.
example_en: The scholar fully studied the Veda along with its six subsidiaries.

definition: the thin, watery, slightly viscid fluid secreted by the salivary glands; saliva; spittle.
example_en: Saliva came into the mouth on seeing the food.

definition: an insignificant human being.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಒಬ್ಬ ನರಜಂತು ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He considered himself an insignificant human being.

definition: the split pod or seed of certain leguminous plants.
example_en: She brought the split lentils needed for cooking from the shop.

definition: the tree Trapa bispinosa of Trapaceae family.
example_en: The water-chestnut tree had grown at the edge of the pond.

definition: a hand that has lumpy veins.
example: ವಯಸ್ಸಾದವನ ಗಂಟುಗೈ ನೋಡಿ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಕರುಣೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: Seeing the old man's lumpy-veined hand, the son felt pity.

definition: the act or an instance of roaring, as a bull.
example_en: The bull's roar was heard from far away.

definition: (masc.) an expert in astrology.
example_en: That astrology expert knew the movements of the planets.

definition: a marriage between persons of different castes, social class, etc.; inter-marriage.
example_en: The family members accepted the inter-caste marriage.

definition: the plant Allium cepa of Liliaceae family; onion plant.
example_en: The farmer grew an onion crop in the field.

definition: the fact of being reflective of light (as a polished metal surface, mirror, etc.).
example_en: The shine of the silver vessel dazzled the eyes.

definition: pasta made of wheat flour in the form of long, thin strings, cooked by boiling or steaming and served with a sauce; spaghetti.
example_en: On the festival day they made spaghetti-like vermicelli pudding.

definition: a water bird; a water-fowl.
example_en: Water-fowls were catching fish on the bank of the pond.

definition: a share of the produce from a land to be given to the owner by the cultivator.
example_en: The landowner's share of the produce used to be given every year.

definition: an assemblage of crows.
example: ಆಲದ ಮರದ ಬಳಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಾಗೆಕೂಟ ಸೇರಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large assemblage of crows had gathered near the banyan tree.

definition: that which is protuberated, bulged out; a swollen part or thing.
example: ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಡುಬ್ಬ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A swollen bulge was visible on the wall.

definition: (pl.) two sides; both the sides.
example_en: People gathered from both the sides.

definition: to incline toward; to have or show a favourable disposition to; to like very much.
example_en: She always inclines favourably toward good deeds.

definition: a considering or being considered carefully and in detail.
example_en: The committee carried out a detailed consideration of the proposal.

definition: to make (coins, money, etc.) by stamping metal; to mint.
example_en: They minted silver coins.

definition: to stretch one's hand.
example_en: He stretched his hand towards me for help.

definition: the inner portion, region of anything.
example: ಕೋಟೆಯ ಹ್ರಿದ್ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಗುಪ್ತ ಕೊಠಡಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a secret room in the inner region of the fort.

definition: a word composed of two or more base morphemes or existing words, whether hyphenated or not; a compound word.
example_en: It is difficult to split a compound word and write it.

definition: she who bestows success, wealth, fame, etc.
example: ಅವಳನ್ನು ಯಶೋದೆ ಎಂದೇ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಗೌರವದಿಂದ ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Everyone respectfully calls her Yaśode, the bestower of fame.

definition: splashing; blobbing; sprinkling.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ಸಿಡುಕಲು ಹನಿಗಳು ಕಿಟಕಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The splashing raindrops fell on the window.

definition: existing at the present moment; present.
example_en: This is a suitable solution for the present situation.

definition: a kind of raw salt.
example: ಆ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಡುಲವಣ ಅಗ್ಗದ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Raw salt is available at a cheap price in that market.

definition: a shed for sheltering livestock; a cattle-shed; a corral.
example_en: The farmer tied the cattle in the cattle-shed.

definition: the tree Anacardium occidentale of Anacardiaceae family; cashew nut tree.
example_en: There are many cashew nut trees in this garden.

definition: (pl.) two sides; both the sides.
example_en: They had planted trees on both sides.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The goṭṭacce plant had grown at the edge of the open field.

definition: to represent or describe as being like or similar; to compare; to liken.
example_en: The poet likened the moon to a face.

definition: to strike, beat; to give a glow.
example_en: He struck the door and made a noise.

definition: a very greedy man.
example_en: The very greedy merchant did not spare even the poor.

definition: the aloe plant Aloe vera (var. officinalis) of Liliaceae family.
example_en: They grow the aloe plant for medicine.

definition: the tree Psidium guajava ( = P. pyriferum) of Myrtaceae family; guava tree.
example_en: The cattle rested in the shade of the guava tree.

definition: a written contract in which one party guarantees to insure another against a specified loss, damage, injury, etc. in consideration of payment of periodic premiums; a policy.
example_en: He purchased a new insurance policy.

definition: one who fights with his hand; a boxer; a wrestler.
example_en: That wrestler won the match.
